_comment: Instant booking for the paid consultation. Each option is a live Stripe payment link in the SIA "Stonks" account; Stripe Tax adds 21% VAT on top of the shown price (verified at checkout: 100 EUR -> 121 EUR). To finish the one-click flow, set each link's After payment behaviour in Stripe to redirect to `calendarUrl`; until that URL is set the copy promises a follow-up instead of an instant calendar, so nothing on the page is untrue.
